proof:

1. Perpendicular(A,B,A,C) => Angle_B_A_C - pi/2

13. Angle_C_E_G + Angle_D_C_E - pi & Angle_D_C_E - Angle_D_C_G - Angle_E_C_G & Angle_C_E_G + Angle_C_G_E + Angle_E_C_G - pi => Angle_C_G_E - Angle_D_C_G
14. Perpendicular(A,B,A,C) & Parallel(A,C,B,D) => Perpendicular(A,B,B,D)
15. Perpendicular(A,B,B,D) => Angle_A_B_D - pi/2

20. Angle_B_A_C - pi/2 & Angle_A_B_G + Angle_A_G_B + Angle_B_A_G - pi & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_C_A_G - pi & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_B_D_C - pi & Angle_A_G_B - pi/2 & Angle_B_A_C - Angle_B_A_G - Angle_C_A_G => Angle_A_B_G - Angle_B_D_C

25. Angle_A_B_C - Angle_A_B_D + Angle_C_B_D & Angle_A_B_D - pi/2 & Angle_B_D_C - Angle_C_B_D & Angle_A_C_B - Angle_A_C_D + Angle_B_C_D & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_B_D_C - pi & Angle_A_B_C - Angle_A_C_B => Angle_B_C_D - pi/2

28. Perpendicular(A,G,B,G) & Parallel(B,C,B,G) => Perpendicular(A,G,B,C)
29. IsoscelesTriangle(A,B,C) & Length_A_B - Length_A_C & Collinear(B,C,G) & Perpendicular(A,G,B,C) => Midpoint(G,B,C)
30. Angle_A_B_C - Angle_A_B_D + Angle_C_B_D & Angle_B_D_C - Angle_C_B_D & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_C_A_G - pi & Angle_A_C_D + Angle_B_D_C - pi & Angle_A_B_C + Angle_A_C_B + Angle_B_A_C - pi & Angle_A_B_D + Angle_B_A_C - pi => Angle_A_C_B - Angle_C_A_G

35. Length_A_G - Length_C_G & Length_A_E - Length_B_C & Length_B_C - 2*Length_C_G => -1/2 + Length_A_G/Length_A_E
36. Midpoint(G,B,C) & Collinear(A,E,G) & -1/2 + Length_A_G/Length_A_E => Centroid(A,B,C,E)
